sources.locator: Complete PDF retrieved. Inspected §§1.1, 1.2.2–1.2.3 and 1.3.1, PDF pp. 1–16, including the full periodic cell, effective tensor, averaging, two-scale compactness/decomposition, oscillating-test homogenization, and cutoff-corrector arguments.

contents.name: Periodic scalar cell space, corrector equation, and energy characterization
contents.detail: Used for the periodic variational convention; cell coercivity, existence, tensor symmetry and ellipticity are proved locally.

contents.name: Periodic averaging lemma and two-scale test convention
contents.detail: The local averaging proof supplies the cube tiling, uniform L2 rescaling bound, and density extension.

contents.name: Two-scale compactness and structure of bounded gradients
contents.detail: The diagonal/Riesz compactness argument and Fourier potential construction are written in full locally.

contents.name: Oscillating-test identification of the homogenized Dirichlet equation
contents.detail: The local proof identifies the cell equation and averaged flux and removes subsequences by uniqueness.

contents.name: Boundary-cutoff first-order corrector estimate
contents.detail: The local proof derives the flux-potential residual and boundary-strip estimate under the stated C2 hypothesis.

sources.title: Zhongwei Shen, Lectures on Periodic Homogenization of Elliptic Systems (complete 246-page lecture text)
sources.locator: Complete PDF retrieved. Inspected Chapter 1 §§1.2–1.3 and Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.2, printed pp. 9–23 and 35–45, including the full corrector/flux-potential and boundary-layer reasoning.

contents.name: Periodic corrector existence and homogenized matrix
contents.detail: Lax–Milgram and the energy representation are locally verified under the scalar ellipticity hypotheses.

contents.name: Two-scale gradient decomposition and cell identification
contents.detail: The local Fourier argument constructs the mean-zero periodic potential, rather than importing the decomposition without proof.

contents.name: Antisymmetric flux corrector and square-root boundary-layer rate
contents.detail: The local item constructs the potential by Fourier coefficients; the dependent cutoff estimate proves its use.

contents.name: Nonaligned sampling error and scale-ratio dependence
contents.detail: The one-dimensional harmonic-mean formula and explicit remainder-period estimate are proved locally.
